request.project_summary:
Trusted single-user general-purpose official norns/grid emulator on Ubuntu20.04 WSL2, testing and practical PC use. Mosaic optional. H01 adds real desktop audio; MIDI-only constraints superseded by explicit user authorization.
# H01 integration candidate

Status: implemented and measured, pending bounded integration review and merge.
Official runtime base remains 14bbeae8646c6717f6bb44c8cd60250bf94b6042.
H00 reference commits and licensing decisions remain in references/H00.json.
No community runtime replacement or copied community implementation is included.

The launcher accepts an explicit Pulse server and sink. A session-owned C helper
transfers its existing crone JACK stereo output to PulseAudio with bounded memory,
nonblocking JACK callback, explicit route failure, no fallback migration and owned
cleanup. The helper manifest binds its binary and source digest. No default
installation is promoted. This is real-time only. Browser controls keep the same
native input path. Maiden and further browser transport changes remain queued.

The optional startup-chime patch guards only the official boot synth, preserving
its default. Rationale, upstream inspection and removal condition are recorded in
H01-progress.md. The environment override is cleared unless explicitly requested.
Old builds reject unsupported suppression. Build with build_audio_candidate.py,
prepare_audio_monitor.py then prepare_desktop_audio.py; see docs/AUDIO-DEVICES.md.
Current local candidate: .runtime/desktop-tools-03/installation.json.

## Automated evidence

All paths below are under artifacts/audio, retained locally with recordings/logs
and source/runtime identities in reports. Exact runners are tests/startup_chime.py,
tests/desktop_audio.py, tests/desktop_audio_failures.py, and
Windows tests/windows_desktop_audio.py. No Mosaic or physical input is required.

- startup-chime-20260908-215318: three checks for retained default, suppression,
  old-build explicit rejection. Chime218/223Hz RMS.06962, opt-out silence0.
- desktop-20260908-215629: ten actual WSLg per-stream signal/lifecycle checks,
  including independent 440/880Hz sessions, stopping one while the other continues,
  restart and all owned PID/stream removal. ToneRMS approximately.141418.
- desktop-failures-20260908-221516: missing server, missing sink and selected sink
  removal fail explicitly; fallback sink unused; all owned processes reaped.
  Private test daemon uses extracted Ubuntu packages, manifest hashes recorded in
  .runtime/pulse-test-packages/manifest.json. No shared WSLg daemon changes.
  Its monitor prepends about1.82sec silence; six-second recording retained and
  last two seconds checked at unchanged tone thresholds. Paired JACK is clean.
- windows-desktop-20260908-220118: four actual Windows WASAPI endpoint tone/silence
  checks. Optional PyAudioWPatch0.2.12.8 installed in a dedicated test environment,
  download provenance .runtime/windows-audio-install.json; no copied library code.
- windows-desktop-20260908-222105: simultaneous JACK, WSLg sink and Windows capture
  all clean at440/880Hz, energy fraction>.9999997, no adjacent jump>.04. Shutdown
  verified including strict service exit codes. Endpoint silence0 before/after.
- Top-level unittest discovery:22 passed. Contract discovery:64 passed and two
  module import errors due omitted PYTHONPATH; corrected targeted invocation
  `env PYTHONPATH=src:tests/contracts python3 -m unittest test_audio_monitor
  test_clients` passes the four missing checks, covering all68. Source unchanged
  between these runs. Later changes only add boundary diagnostics to audio tests.

## Remaining limitations for review

A repeat Windows capture while contract tests ran, windows-desktop-20260908-221650,
contains25zero samples at.539433s and two audible-sized jumps; RMS correct but
frequency purity failed. Helper had no JACK/Pulse fault and cleanup succeeded.
The cause is not localized because that run lacked simultaneous boundaries.
Do not claim the historical clicks solved, uninterrupted arbitrary-duration PC
output, hardware equivalence, or interactive latency. The subsequent simultaneous
probe passed. This failure remains evidence, not a waived threshold.

Pulse underflows and JACK faults have explicit code paths; the selected-sink-loss
check tests a real backend fault, not every callback or host scheduling condition.
Windows endpoint is a software render-loopback measurement, not a microphone or
physical speaker measurement. macOS/Apple Silicon/Docker are untested. No new
engine beyond the demonstrated TestSine is implied by this desktop transport.

Three further independent startup/stop trials also passed at the Windows endpoint,
with simultaneous JACK and sink recordings: windows-desktop-20260908-222225,
222255 and222325 (four checks each). These bounded trials do not erase221650.

content.text:
## What works

- `src/runtime/audio/jack_desktop.c:31` checks `"frames!=block || jack_ringbuffer_write_space(ring)<bytes"` before copying. Allocation and Pulse writes stay outside the JACK callback; buffer exhaustion fails explicitly.
- `src/runtime/audio/jack_desktop.c:79` uses `"PA_STREAM_DONT_MOVE|PA_STREAM_ADJUST_LATENCY"`. The no-migration flag matches [PulseAudio’s contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pulseaudio/pulseaudio/v13.0/src/pulse/def.h), and the retained sink-loss report records explicit failure and reaped processes.
- `src/runtime/native.py:168` calls `"self.env.pop('NORNS_EMU_STARTUP_CHIME',None)"` before applying explicit suppression. The committed chime patch’s SHA256 matches the candidate manifest, and its conditional preserves the upstream default.
- `docs/delivery/completions/H01.md:60` states `"This failure remains evidence, not a waived threshold."` The retained Windows report confirms the frequency-purity failure; subsequent passes have separate reports. These are inspected artifacts, not tests executed during this review.

## What doesn't work

- **[MAJOR] Negative lifecycle acceptance hides unrelated service crashes.** `tests/desktop_audio_failures.py:84` accepts `"error.code=='cleanup_failed'"`, while line 31 checks only that each PID disappeared. A crone or JACK crash during sink-loss cleanup therefore still produces a passing scenario; the missing-route cases similarly accept a preserved `backend_dead` error containing additional cleanup failures. Assert the expected desktop-helper exit for each scenario and normal allowed exits for every other service. Also assert the private daemon’s exit: line 97 merely records `"report['private_server_exit']=proc.returncode"`.

- **[MAJOR] The signal oracle accepts brief audible discontinuities.** `tests/windows_desktop_audio.py:90` requires only `"m['tone_energy_fraction']>.85"` and broad RMS bounds. Its imported oracle, `tests/audio_feasibility.py:49`, additionally discards `"samples[int(rate*.25):-int(rate*.25)]"`. Replacing a short interior span with zeros while retaining subsequent phase passes these aggregate checks; corruption in the discarded tail is ignored entirely. This leaves the disclosed discontinuity class incompletely detected despite the completion record’s `"no adjacent jump>.04"` measurement. Add a bounded continuity assertion with explicit transition exclusions and demonstrate rejection of a short dropout.

- **[MINOR] Nonfinite samples are flagged but still published.** `src/runtime/audio/jack_desktop.c:37` increments `faults` for invalid input, then line 40 executes `"jack_ringbuffer_write(ring,(const char*)scratch,bytes)"`. If the producer publishes between the consumer’s fault check at line 103 and its read, invalid floats reach `pa_stream_write` before failure is reported. Return immediately after flagging the first invalid sample, leaving that block unpublished.

## Risks

- **[MINOR] The Windows dropout remains unlocalized under ordinary concurrent development work.** `docs/delivery/completions/H01-progress.md:118` records failure `"while contract tests ran concurrently"` with no helper fault. Later clean captures establish bounded successes, but do not identify whether the earlier discontinuity originated in transport, host rendering, or capture. Preserve this limitation when admitting the candidate.

## Gaps

Nothing notable.

## Improvements

- **[MINOR] Make stereo routing distinguishable.** `fixtures/probes/desktop-tone/desktop-tone.lua:1` selects `"TestSine"`; its upstream implementation emits `"(SinOsc.ar(hz_) * amp_).dup"`. Additionally, `tests/desktop_audio.py:55` calls `"tone(path,hz)"`, whose default checks only channel zero. One asymmetric stereo stimulus, asserted on both sink channels, would detect swaps, duplication and a missing right channel; cost: one short native probe.
- **[MINOR] Turn the saved boundary recordings into checked evidence.** `tests/windows_desktop_audio.py:85` copies `"name+'-jack.wav'"`, but line 87 analyzes only the Windows `"path"`. Apply signal and continuity assertions to the saved JACK and sink recordings and include their metrics in the report; cost: analysis of the existing files, with no additional capture time.
